- The Heat (how they are when the fire gets under it and the plan comes apart in their hands): Rowan berries — scarlet, and each one carries a five-pointed star on its underside
- The Binding (what they become when there are other people in the room, and what holds them there): Hearth salt — a pinch over the left shoulder first, and the rest of it into the water
